input.summary: Add Customer-only termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees as new Section 9.4
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a Customer right to terminate for convenience on thirty days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, since the three-year term in Section 8.1 otherwise locks us in with no exit absent Vendor breach. Vendor retains no convenience right during a committed term; if helpful, we can discuss 60 days' notice as a fallback.

ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Vendor, without penalty, early-termination fee, or other charge, in which case Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination in accordance with Section 10.2. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience during the term of an Order Form.
